duplicates_and_crossposting.how_same_role_appears: A single opening commonly appears on the company ATS board (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable token), the company careers page, LinkedIn, Indeed, Otta/TrueUp/Levels, and sometimes Remote OK or We Work Remotely. Gulf/Pakistan roles also cross-post across Bayt, GulfTalent, Naukri Gulf, and recruiter pages.
duplicates_and_crossposting.canonical_strategy: Prefer the employer ATS apply URL. Secondary: ATS job id + board_token, or USAJOBS announcement number. Tertiary: normalized title+company+location+posted_week. Never rely solely on LinkedIn or Indeed keys.
dedupe_order: Official government announcement or ATS job ID

tracker_schema_recommendation.notes: Candidate-facing status webhooks were not found. Tracking is manual or via a companion extension (Teal/Huntr/Simplify).

ranked_tactics: Poll free remote feeds: Himalayas, Remote OK, Remotive, We Work Remotely RSS, Arbeitnow.
Manual Gulf relocation: Bayt, GulfTalent, Naukri Gulf.
EU relocation: Landing.jobs, Arbeitnow, Otta, Personio/Teamtailor company boards, Homerun (NL).
Startup discovery then ATS watchlist: YC Work at a Startup, Wellfound, HN Who's Hiring, TrueUp, Levels.fyi.
Poll Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/Recruitee tokens for remote-first companies.
USAJOBS and US-only boards stay listed but score low unless the hiring path is explicit.
pakistan_relocation_remote.honest_base_rate: Pakistan-local and GCC listings accept a Pakistan-based applicant more often than ordinary US software roles. Remote is not the same as remote-from-Pakistan. Never hard-filter; rank instead.

workflow: Find the company on a board.
Identify ATS vendor and board token/slug.
Poll the official public endpoint if one exists.
Add the company to the watchlist.
Treat aggregator pages as cross-posts of the ATS URL.
